learning_outcomes.text: Describe the characteristics and function of each of the elements that make up hydraulic machines. Types of hydraulic machines. Characteristic curves and application in pumping, ventilation or turbining installations
Design pumping installations. Calculate and select the most suitable pump and regulation system
Know the characteristics, operation, and design parameters of hydraulic turbines
Applied knowledge of the fundamentals of fluid mechanical systems and machines.

assessment_rules: There are two evaluation options: Option 1 (Exam + Practicals) and Option 2 (Final Exam). For Option 1, the final grade is computed as 80% for the exam and 20% for practicals; this requires explicit declaration and completion of practical sessions. For Option 2, the final grade corresponds to the final exam score. All extraordinary calls are evaluated exclusively via Option 2. To pass the written exam (which has theory and problem parts), a minimum score of 40% must be obtained in each part; otherwise, the final exam grade will be capped at 3.9. If Option 1 is chosen, a minimum grade of 4 (out of 10) in the practicals part is also required to average with the exam, failing which the final grade will be the exam grade, capped at 3.9.
